distributed_item_autoset.shownName: Add distributed items to application on the group set

user_can_request_access.shownName: User can request access to the group
user_can_request_access.helpText: User can request access to the group in his / her application. Responsible master will have to approve or decline access. Group can not be for gamemasters only.

get_child_groups.description: Get the list of positions a group can take inside the given parent group, plus the current position of the group being edited. Changes nothing.

params.obj_id: ID of the parent group; empty means top-level groups
params.group_id: ID of the group being edited, to exclude it from the list and return its current position; 0 for a new group

get_responsible_gamemaster.description: Get the ID of the gamemaster responsible for the given project group. Changes nothing.

change_character_code.description: Reorder a character inside a project group: it takes the position right after the given character and the order of the rest is recalculated.

params.obj_id: ID of the character being moved
params.group_id: ID of the group whose order is changed
params.after_obj_id: ID of the character it is placed after; 0 means place it first

change_group_code.description: Move a project group within the group tree: make it a child or a sibling of the given group. Codes and nesting of the other groups are recalculated.

params.obj_id: ID of the group being moved
params.level: Where to place it relative to after_obj_id: child — inside it, sibling — next to it on the same level
params.after_obj_id: ID of the group the move is relative to; 0 means place it first at the top level
